cohort: Antenatal booked mothers attending the Obstetrics and gynecology department of Tripura Medical College & Dr BRAM Teaching Hospital, Agartala, who delivered at the hospital during the 12-month study period.
finding: Maternal obesity was significantly correlated with increased rates of preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertension, and an increased requirement for labor induction and surgical interference.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity was associated with a higher need for induction of labour and caesarean section.
